semiconductor_relevance: High — Macrotest specializes in semiconductor testing equipment, making it a key player in the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Macrotest Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, production, and sales of semiconductor testing equipment. The company provides solutions for back-end packaging and testing, serving both domestic and international semiconductor manufacturers and design companies.

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Nanjing with operations and production centers in the same city, along with branch offices and technical service centers in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Taiwan, Japan, and Southeast Asia.
